guidelines.title: Reporting Guidelines
guidelines.orgBody: Demo Co PLC. Head Office: 1 Demo Plaza, Industrial District, City Center.
guidelines.scopeBody: Operational performance of Demo Co Group entities for the reporting year, including companies in which Demo Co holds ≥ 50% of total shares, plus Polymers JV Ltd. (Demo Co holds 41.44%, largest shareholder). Sustainability data covers > 75% of total revenue.
guidelines.restatementsBody: Where the current report revises prior-year figures, the restatement is annotated against the affected line item.
guidelines.assuranceBody: Limited assurance by LRQA Group Limited (ISAE 3000 revised), ref. BGK00001264. Assurance statement is appended at the end of this report.

assurance.title: LRQA Independent Assurance Statement
assurance.subtitle: ISAE 3000 (revised) · Ref BGK00001264
assurance.p1: LRQA Group Limited provides limited assurance on GC’s Sustainability Performance Data in accordance with ISAE 3000 (revised) and at the materiality of the professional judgement of the verifier, using LRQA’s verification procedure based on the principles of inclusivity, materiality, responsiveness, impact, and reliability of performance data.
assurance.p2: Assurance covers GC’s operations in Thailand and specific GRI disclosures: GRI 302-1, 302-3, 303-3/4/5, 305-7, 306-3/4/5, 308-2, 403-9/10, 405-2, 414-2, GRI 11.8.3, and OGSS OG13.
assurance.placeholderBody: — full LRQA assurance statement is inserted here at final publish. Detailed terms of engagement, observations, and conclusion match the standing assurance template (see Demo Co FY2025 SPD pp. 60–61).
